documents.description: Full or partial documents, matched by `id`.

aggs.description:
Aggregations keyed by name (terms, histogram, date_histogram, range,
stats, composite, ...).

consistency.description:
Read-your-writes (#255): "strong" also scans the namespace's
acknowledged-but-unindexed writes; "eventual" searches indexed segments
only. Unset uses the server default (KOSHA_DEFAULT_CONSISTENCY, itself
strong).

exact_total_hits.description: Count every match instead of stopping at `total_hits_cap`.

fields.description:
Restrict query_text to these Text fields, each optionally boosted:
["title^2", "content"]. Empty = every Text field; "_all" names that
explicitly.

max_staleness_seconds.description:
Query replicas only (#232): accept a manifest at most this many
seconds old instead of checking the control store first.

mode.description:
"lexical", "semantic" or "hybrid". Unset infers it from the clauses
present; a set value is checked against them.

query_text.description:
The lexical query; "" for a query with no lexical part (kNN only,
filter only, fuzzy).

rank_by.description:
Score modifiers: field-value boosts and linear / exp / gauss decays
over Integer, Float, Date and GeoPoint fields, applied to the best
`window_size` hits. See README "Score modifiers".

search_after.description:
Keyset pagination: the `sort` values of the last hit of the previous
page, as strings.

timings.description:
With the dashboard on (#214): add the phase breakdown `timings` to the
response.

total_hits_cap.description:
Count matches up to this many (default 10,000), then report
`total_hits_relation: "gte"`.

protobufNullValue.description:
`NullValue` is a singleton enumeration to represent the null value for the
`Value` type union.

The JSON representation for `NullValue` is JSON `null`.

storage_reclaimed.description:
False when the namespace was deleted but some of its stored objects
(local segment files or S3 objects) could not be removed. They are
unreferenced and never reused by a re-created namespace.

v1DeletionRecord.description:
One hard delete of a namespace or a tenant, as the control store keeps it
(kosha.deletion_records). Holds identifiers and counters only.

acks_required.description:
Purge pods must acknowledge their cache purge before the record
completes (#347, KOSHA_DELETION_REQUIRE_ACKS).

exports_deleted.description: Exports (#347) of the subject deleted with it.

last_error.description: Why the last attempt did not complete.

last_version.description: Namespace scope: the manifest version the namespace retired at.

objects_deleted.description: Objects deleted from object storage, summed over the attempts.

parent_id.description: The tenant deletion a namespace deletion is part of.

state.description: "pending" (rows gone, stored objects may remain) or "completed".

storage_verified.description: Storage reclaim finished and the prefix listed empty.

subject.description: Internal namespace id ("<tenant>/<name>") or tenant id, per `scope`.

v1ErrorResponse.description:
The body of every non-2xx JSON response, on every route (ADR-350 §b).
See docs/api/errors.md for the code table.

code.description:
The stable machine-readable error code; docs/api/errors.md lists
them. Clients treat an unknown code by its HTTP status and
`retryable`: codes are added without a new API version.

details.description: Code-specific detail. Keys are only ever added.

error.description: Human-readable. Not stable: never parse it.

limit.description:
Deprecated alias kept for tenant-limit rejections: the limit that was
hit.

reason.description:
Deprecated alias kept for tenant-limit rejections: the old reason
string (equal to `code` for the tenant_* codes).

request_id.description: Echoes the `X-Request-Id` response header; quote it in bug reports.

retry_after_ms.description:
Present exactly when `retryable` is true; the `Retry-After` header
carries the same delay in whole seconds.

retryable.description:
Whether the identical request may succeed later; true only when the
server did not apply it. A forwarded write whose outcome is unknown
(`details.outcome: "unknown"`) says false: retry it only if the
operation is idempotent.

field_type.description:
The value's type, PascalCase: "Text", "Keyword", "Integer", "Float",
"Date", "Boolean", "Vector" (value: a JSON array of numbers), or
"GeoPoint" (value: "lat,lon", {"lat": .., "lon": ..} or GeoJSON
[lon, lat]).

value.description: Every value is sent as a string.

analyzer.description:
Analyzer, then token filters. Analyzers: "standard" (legacy tokenizer),
"standard@2" (Unicode UAX #29), "keyword", "lowercase", "whitespace".
Filters: "lowercase", "stop", "stem" (English Snowball). Empty =
"standard".

embedding.description:
Vector fields only (issue #209): the embedding model the server uses to
embed `knn.query_text` and text-valued documents for this field.

indexed.description: Whether the field is full-text indexed.

stopwords.description:
Stopword list for this field's "stop" filter (built-in English list if
empty).

stored.description: Whether the field value is stored and returned.

type.description:
The field type. Accepted spellings: the canonical "FIELD_TYPE_TEXT"
form the server returns, the bare name in any case ("text",
"Keyword"), or the enum number. Types: TEXT, KEYWORD, INTEGER, FLOAT,
DATE, BOOLEAN, VECTOR, GEO_POINT.

max_expansions.description: Terms per token per segment, nearest first (default 50, max 1024).

prefix_length.description: Leading characters that must match exactly (default 0).

transpositions.description: An adjacent swap counts as one edit (default true).

value.description: Analyzed per segment; each token is expanded.

accrued.description: What the month would cost if it ended now: `{lines, total_cents}`.

stored_manifest_version.description:
Query replicas (#232): the stored manifest version last seen, when the
local manifest was last confirmed current (Unix seconds), and how long
ago that was (null if never).

unindexed_documents.description: Writer pods: acknowledged documents not yet in a segment.

vector.description:
The query vector. Omit it and set `query_text` to have the server
embed the text with the field's schema model (#209).

vectors.description:
Late-interaction (multi-vector) query vectors: an array of arrays of
numbers.

documents.description: Null when this node could not load the namespace's manifest.

field.description: The field the phrase must occur in; "", "_all" or "*" = any one field.

fields.description: Several fields, any one of them (overrides field when non-empty).

parent_version.description: Parent manifest version the branch started from.

shared_segments.description: Segments still read from the parent's prefix.

default_analyzer.description: Analyzer for Text fields not listed in `fields`. Empty = "standard".

default_stopwords.description:
Stopword list for `default_analyzer`'s "stop" filter (built-in English
list if empty).

changed.description: False when the stored schema was already identical.

changes.description: The online changes applied, per field (#347).

changed.description: False when the namespace already had this shard count.

v1RankDetails.description:
1-based ranks in each retriever's namespace-wide list; unset when the hit
was not in that retriever's window.

base_score.description: rank_by requests: the score before the modifiers.

field.description: Stored field sent as each document's text.

provider.description: A provider the server has configured.

query.description: Default query_text, then match_phrase.phrase, then fuzzy.value.

v1RrfRank.description: score(d) = sum over retrievers r of 1 / (rank_constant + rank_r(d)).

rank_window_size.description:
Per-retriever list length and fused list length. Default: max_results;
must be >= max_results.

field.description: The field, or "*" for the namespace-wide defaults.

fused_score.description:
Reranked requests only: the first-stage (fused) score, and the
provider's score (= score; unset when the rerank degraded).

highlight.description: Highlight fragments keyed by field name: arrays of strings.

highlights.description:
Deprecated: set only for the legacy single-field highlight request; use
`highlight`.

score.description:
The fused RRF score for a hybrid request; the rerank score when
reranked.

aggregations.description: Aggregation results keyed by the request's aggregation names.

consistency_fallback.description: Set when a "strong" search was answered as "eventual"; says why.

knn_degraded_segments.description:
kNN requests: segments whose vector search failed and contributed no
candidates (0 when every segment searched cleanly).

knn_filtered_candidates.description: Filtered kNN: documents that passed the filter.

rerank_degraded.description:
Reranked requests only: true when the provider timed out or failed and
results are in first-stage order.

timings.description: `"timings": true` requests with the dashboard on (#214).

total_hits_relation.description: "eq" when total_hits is exact, "gte" when it is a capped lower bound.

info.description: The public Kosha HTTP/JSON API. The OpenAPI document is the wire contract; proto3 canonical JSON is not (see docs/api/versioning.md). Every request carries a tenant API key (`Authorization: Bearer <key>` or `X-Api-Key: <key>`), and every namespace in a path is relative to that key's tenant.
